_note: The run's numbers (docs/architecture/run-core.md; sim/core/run.gd). Run-only: no versus match reads this file.

ground._enabled: the one switch: the story mode's host picks each stage's ground (the ring it is fought on) with World's ring picker from Narrative's claims (data/narrative/opponent_grounds.json) only while it is on
ground._framesPerRead: the host reads one candidate ring every this many frames during the previous stage's beats, by the ring's size (World: a read is about 2.6, 5.3 and 10.3 ms natively at Close, Half and Whole, and about 22, 32 and 63 ms on the old laptop); what is left when the beats end is read at once. The pick is the same however it is stepped
ground._stagesBeforeBoss: the stages before the boss (Game Design's run-mode.md 8: the MVP is three stages and the boss); the boss is the chapter after them
ground._phases: the claim's size phase by chapter before the boss (run-mode.md 2: early is stages 1 and 2, then mid); a chapter past the list takes its last. The first stage is always Close round the player's home, and the boss Whole
ground._provingSize: a Proving ground's ring (run-mode.md 1.2: a Proving ground is Close)
